title: A pattern that exceeds the dry-run budget
teaches: Pattern tracks are queried under a fixed 1 MiB frame scratch at load time. A cycle dense enough to exhaust it is a load diagnostic (pattern_eval_failed, 27), not a silent every-frame omission and not a process OOM.
observe: (fast 8000 (pure 1)) asks for 8000 haps in one cycle.
The dry-run exhausts the frame budget before any table exists.
pack exits 1 and reports pattern_eval_failed at the pattern span.
There is no PACB carrier to load.
